findings.description:
Reentrancy in RMTReclaimCampaignV2._pay(address,uint256) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#104-108):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- ! IReclaimV2ERC20(rewardToken).transfer(to,amount) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#106)
	Balance read before the call:
	- a = IReclaimV2ERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(address(this)) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#105)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- IReclaimV2ERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(address(this)) + amount != a || IReclaimV2ERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(to) != b + amount (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#107)
		- stale variable `a`
findings.protectedAssets: Funded reward reserve and exact claimant/controller payout
findings.stateTransition: reserve/paid or recovery counters are updated before guarded transfer; exact sender and recipient deltas are mandatory
findings.potentialReentry: Typed token call can attempt callbacks; state-changing campaign entry points require entered==1 while the call is entered==2
findings.invariant: Actual standard-token balance deltas, permanent retirement/supply/ownership evidence and atomic rollback; invariantEveryPaidRewardHasPermanentRetirementAndConservedBacking
findings.assumptions: Production must bind the actual independently reviewed fixed-supply TokenV2 runtime; a malicious token can lie about balances and is not admitted by the canonical fixture profile
findings.uncertainty: Passing finite tests is not a proof for every external token/collection or future chain state. Strict analysis remains failed and independent disposition is not claimed.
findings.assessment: The reported pre-call balance is deliberately compared to its exact expected transfer delta. No concrete defect was established in the pinned reviewed-source profile. Hostile profile tests are counterfactual only; finite tests do not establish universal safety. Static finding remains unresolved and gate remains failed.

Reentrancy in RMTReclaimCampaignV2._sink721(address,uint256,uint64) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#244-251):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,permanentSink,id,abi.encode(receiptId)) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#247)
	Balance read before the call:
	- fromBalance = IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).balanceOf(msg.sender) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#246)

	- IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).ownerOf(id) != permanentSink || IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).balanceOf(permanentSink) != sinkBalance + 1 || IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).balanceOf(msg.sender) + 1 != fromBalance || afterSupply != beforeSupply (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#249-250)
		- stale variable `fromBalance`

limits: The configurable hostile token/NFT fixtures are explicitly counterfactual and not approved production profiles. Their admission in isolated test-only factories exercises failure assertions.
The real reward token source/runtime must be pinned and independently verified; arbitrary tokens can lie about balances.
Every native-burn or sink collection requires verified immutable source semantics excluding issuer seizure, proxy upgrades and retired-ID remint. ERC-165/runtime hashing alone is insufficient.
The pure immutable sink has no NFT return/repayment/rescue/approval/admin/upgrade path; forced NFTs remain stranded and earn no reward.
All seven V2 highs and prior V1/core/treasury holds remain unresolved; tests do not clear a security gate.
No public transaction, production data write, signing, service change or new feature is part of this work.
